response.sql: WITH album_rates AS (SELECT AlbumId, COUNT(*) AS track_count, 1.0 * SUM(Bytes) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN Bytes IS NOT NULL THEN Milliseconds END), 0) AS rate FROM Track GROUP BY AlbumId), album_mean AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS mean_rate FROM album_rates) SELECT AVG(a.rate) AS average_rate, AVG(a.track_count) AS average_track_count, AVG(a.rate - m.mean_rate) AS average_amount_above_mean FROM album_rates AS a CROSS JOIN album_mean AS m WHERE a.rate > m.mean_rate;

assumptions.assumption: An album’s rate is total known bytes divided by the duration of tracks with known bytes. Track count includes tracks with missing sizes; tracks with no AlbumId form one group.

alternatives.interpretation: An album’s rate is the average of its individual tracks’ bytes-per-millisecond rates.
